question: How many members does each cooperative have?
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(m.id) AS member_count FROM cooperatives c JOIN members m ON m.cooperative_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY member_count DESC

question: What are the top 5 products by total quantity sold?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which orders have not been fully paid?
sql: SELECT o.id, o.total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount), 0) AS paid_amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments pay ON pay.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.total_amount HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pay.amount), 0) < o.total_amount

question: List members who joined in the last 30 days.
sql: SELECT full_name, joined_at FROM members WHERE joined_at >= date('now', '-30 day') ORDER BY joined_at DESC

question: What is the total revenue per cooperative this year?
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM cooperatives c JOIN members m ON m.cooperative_id = c.id JOIN orders o ON o.member_id = m.id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.created_at) = strftime('%Y', 'now') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Show the 10 most recent orders with the member name.
sql: SELECT o.id, m.full_name, o.total_amount, o.created_at FROM orders o JOIN members m ON m.id = o.member_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which products have never been ordered?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL

question: What is the average order value per member?
sql: SELECT m.full_name, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM members m JOIN orders o ON o.member_id = m.id GROUP BY m.full_name ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
